race.comment: HORSESHOE HILL (9) bumped into some handy types last prep at Group level and appears to be back in good order. Shouldered the 59kg first up when third to Bruce I Am over 1000m at Warwick Farm. That form has since been franked and a win looks imminent. NITRO (4) win record hardly excites but has the ability to take this out. Closed well first up with the 60kg when sixth over 1300m at Warwick Farm in a fast run contest. Kept up to the mark with a tick over trial and look for a better run. ANNIE'S ROSE (2) saves her best for this track and far from disgraced when ninth in The Nivison G3 at this track over 1200m. Claim helps and will be strong late. NULLARBOR JANE (6) up in class first up and not to be overlooked with the two solid trial trial wins. CHEMTRAIL (13) holding form in weaker company and don't dismiss with the sharp weight drop.
